findings.claim: C1: The candidate preserves successful legacy admission and rejects fallback after a legacy integrity error. Its installed fallback requires every declared data scope to have a matching current lock grant; it preserves disabled readiness.
findings.evidence: material-0 (EcommerceWorkshopReadCatalog.get_readiness): preserves legacy result on success; catches only AssetNotFoundError, lets Integrity error pass; granted subset is computed from DataScopeGrant refs requiring exact installation:revision/lock:lock_revision and authority=postgres:bundle_composition_lock; disallowed blockers reject non-permitted types unless INSTALLED_ASSET_READONLY on the installation; raises AssetNotFoundError when required<=granted fails. material-1: test_legacy_success_is_preserved_without_reading_candidate passes legacy result unchanged. test_legacy_integrity_error_never_falls_back asserts RegistryIntegrityCorruptError is re-raised. test_declared_scope_without_current_lock_grant_is_rejected asserts rejection when scopes empty. test_exact_granted_installed_asset_can_pass_read_gate_without_runtime_promotion asserts result.item.readiness.value=='disabled' and presence of INSTALLED_ASSET_READONLY blocker. test_grant_reference_must_match_current_exact_lock, test_grant_from_another_revision_or_authority_is_rejected, test_candidate_bundle_content_drift_is_not_hidden_by_fallback confirm lock/hash/authority precision.

findings.claim: C2: The isolated candidate and adjacent catalog/HTTP regression run passed 66 tests. No router was changed and no HTTP activation, real database write, runtime admission or business completion is claimed.
findings.evidence: material-3 shows '66 passed, 7 warnings in 4.49s' with no failures. material-2 explicitly states '本轮先实现独立适配器，尚不接任何HTTP route' and '未激活GET、未重启、未改真库、未运行Provider'; next steps (第3/8 through 第8/8) including route wiring are listed as pending. material-0 and material-4 contain only the adapter/catalog implementation and _EmptySource placeholder; no router diff or activation claim is present.
